title: The frontmatter of a floor agent file

model.description: The model the agent runs on.

image.description: The container image the agent runs in. Required in a file that defines an agent.

timeout_minutes.description: How long a visit may run, in minutes. Required in a file that defines an agent.

tags.description: Which cluster agents may run it. A cluster agent claims a visit only when it offers every tag.

input_per_million.description: US dollars for a million input tokens.

output_per_million.description: US dollars for a million output tokens.

cache_read_per_million.description: US dollars for a million tokens read from the cache. The input price when not stated.

cache_write_per_million.description: US dollars for a million tokens written to the cache. The input price when not stated.

prices.description: Model name to what it costs, for a model that reports tokens and no cost.

skills.description: Names of the skills the agent is given.

skills_source.description: The address the pod downloads the agent's skills from, usually the host's skills service. Without it the pod asks the floor, which has no skills to give.

name.description: The name the agent knows the server by.

transport.description: How the server is reached. `stdio` is a process the pod starts. `http` and `sse` are an address it calls.

command.description: `stdio` only, and required there. The command that starts the server.

url.description: `http` and `sse` only, and required there. The server's address.

headers_secret.description: The key in `agent-secrets`, the Kubernetes Secret in the agents' namespace, holding one whole header line, such as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

name.description: The name of the header or environment variable.

ref.description: The key in `agent-secrets`, the Kubernetes Secret in the agents' namespace, whose value it gets.

headers.description: `http` and `sse` only. Headers sent to the server, each taking its value from a key in `agent-secrets`.

name.description: The name of the header or environment variable.

ref.description: The key in `agent-secrets`, the Kubernetes Secret in the agents' namespace, whose value it gets.

env.description: `stdio` only. Environment variables of the server's process, each taking its value from a key in `agent-secrets`.

mcp_servers.description: The MCP servers the agent can call.

disallowed_tools.description: Tools the agent may not use.

env.description: Environment variables of the agent, as plain values.

permission_mode.description: `bypass` (the default) lets the agent run any tool without asking. `auto` keeps the CLI's own permission checks, so in the pod, where nobody can answer, an action that needs approval is refused.

max_turns.description: The most turns the agent takes in one visit.

model_secret_key.description: Which key in `agent-secrets`, the Kubernetes Secret in the agents' namespace, holds the model's API key. Without it, the key the install sets for the model's family is used.

limits.description: What the pod may not exceed.

pod_resources.description: The resources of the agent's container. With none, the cluster's default applies.

config.description: Settings for the agent's pod. A key the floor does not know is kept and not acted on.
